name: Pylon
description: Access Pylon's customer support platform directly from Claude to search, manage, and resolve customer issues. Stay on top of your support queue while connecting Claude's insights to real customer conversations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pylon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pylon to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.usepylon.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pylon MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pylon provides these MCP tools: create_issue, get_account, get_contact, get_issue, get_issue_messages, get_user, search_accounts, search_issues, update_account, and update_issue.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pylon?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pylon in customer-support on the Manufact MCP catalog include Assembled, Brainfish, ClearFeed, Conduit, and DevRev.
Pylon requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pylon is developed by Pylon. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
